Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 3), the Planner incorrectly identified the event as the "1984 Asian Games" instead of the "1984 South Asian Games" (also known as the 1st SAF Games). While the WebSurfer correctly retrieved information confirming the event was the "South Asian Games" held in Kathmandu, the Planner failed to accurately synthesize this information, hallucinating the name "Asian Games" (which is a different, larger event typically held in Asia but not specifically in Kathmandu in 1984 under that name). This led to an incorrect final answer.
